name: splunk_copilot_evidence_ledger
description: Evidence-centric ledger for agentic Splunk incident investigation. Shared asset with the find_evil DFIR agent (same provenance-chain design).

event_type.description: ingestion | search | alert | triage | containment | verification

source.description: Origin of the record (e.g. correlation_search:CS-EXFIL-004, splunk_event_store)

spl.description: The SPL search that produced this record (re-runnable in real Splunk)

ops_class.description: Ops failure class (e.g. auth_bruteforce, data_exfiltration, service_error_cascade)

evidence_pointer.description: Provenance refs to source event rows (e.g. web_access.jsonl:15; fw_traffic.jsonl:2)

example_record.summary: [T1567.002/data_exfiltration] 3 bulk /api/export/customers calls from 192.0.2.50 moved ~64.5 MB; firewall confirms the matching outbound byte spike.
example_record.notes: Correlation search CS-EXFIL-004; MITRE T1567.002. Synthetic data.
example_record.spl: index=web sourcetype=access_combined uri_path="/api/export/customers" status=200 | where bytes > 1000000 | stats count as exports sum(bytes) as total_bytes by clientip
example_record.recommendation: Block egress to the destination; add DLP + rate caps on bulk export.
